channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Anthropic enters personal AI assistant race with Duet, joining Meta and OpenAI
item.description: Claude Duet offers existing subscribers a personal assistant as Anthropic competes to secure a place in users' daily routines.

item.title: Torani CEO says layoffs are a choice as 570,000 workers lost jobs this year
item.description: Melanie Dulbecco, CEO of flavored syrup giant Torani, rejects the idea that laying off employees is always necessary and says her company has never cut workers en masse.

item.title: Energy markets adapt to Iran war as 'forever conflict' while producers maintain supply
item.description: Repeated supply shocks are driving a lasting reconfiguration of trade routes and energy corridors, with tail risks remaining elevated.

item.title: An $8 billion Treasury break helped bring Meta's tax rate to 2%. Now it has a week to answer senators about data center tax credits
item.description: Senators want Meta to explain why it claims a research credit on AI data centers. Meta says the facilities require real experimentation.
